messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: P1 - spike in 5xxs for hosted inference (api.redwood.ai). Pager: @elaine. Auto-created incident channel #incident-1827654321 :rotating_light:
elaine: I'm on it. seeing alerts for 5xx spike starting ~1827654000. Can folks post any recent deploys/changes?
sam: I pushed a small batching tweak to runtime yesterday, commit bb3f2a6. It touched dynamic batch window logic. Deployed to canary and then rolled to prod at 1827651200 UTC.
maria: Noted. Customer impact? I see elevated errors for streaming endpoints and some increased latency for short requests. Dashboard: error-rate up to 8% from 0.4% for last 20m.
anil: grabbing logs now. attaching tail from router hosts (truncated):
```
[1827654012] router-01 ERROR upstream: connect failed: 503
[1827654013] router-02 WARN kv-cache miss rate 11% (baseline 2%)
[1827654020] runtime-03 ERROR model-infer: failed to allocate IO buffer: out of memory
[1827654031] runtime-01 INFO fallback to cpu-quant model variant
```
matt: interesting OOMs on runtime-03. we had a kernel tweak in the last runtime release too but that was earlier this week. any autoscaler events?
rebecca: autoscaler shows many pods flapping, backoff loops. We saw spike in request qps around 1827653940.
elaine: hypothesis A: batching tweak increased peak memory usage leading to OOMs and 503s. Hypothesis B: unrelated infra memory pressure from a separate rollout. Let's track.
sam: I can quickly revert the batching tweak in the canary to confirm. Will run a revert test on canary first. Owner: @sam. ETA 10m.
maria: I'll open a scoped mitigation: disable streaming-prefetch at runtime config to reduce mem pressure. Owner: @maria. ETA 5m.
anil: adding timeline so far: 1827651200 - batching tweak rolled to prod; 1827653940 - QPS spike; 1827654012 - first 503s/ooms alerted.
matt: logs from runtime-03:
```
E 03:41:12 Alloc failed 256MB for batch window
Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File "/srv/runtime/infer.py", line 732, in serve_batch
MemoryError
```
rebecca: running quick canary traffic with revert (sam) will be great. also suggest throttling new large-batch requests: add rate-limit rule for batch_size>64 to 10rps. I can flip that. Owner: @rebecca.
sam: revert applied to canary at 1827654210. monitor logs... canary 503s dropped to baseline within 60s. Looks promising.
maria: I disabled streaming-prefetch on one runtime pool (pool B) at 1827654235. memory pressure reduced and OOMs stopped on pool B.
elaine: good signs. So A seems likely. We should run a controlled revert in prod on a small % (canary-style) while keeping autoscale and rate limits. Plan: 1) revert batching tweak on 20% of traffic -> 2) observe 5m -> 3) if good, roll forward full revert and then schedule a safer rework. Owners: revert @sam, rate-limit @rebecca, monitoring @anil.
matt: agree. Also collect heap profiles from runtime instances that spiked. @sam can you coordinate with infra to pull pprof from runtime-03 and runtime-01 around 1827654000-1827654100.
sam: requesting pprof snapshots now. will attach when available.
anil: saving key logs and will push to incident drive: https://internal.redwood/incident/1827654321/logs (privileged link)
rebecca: quick mitigation applied: rate-limit for large batches in prod at 1827654280. seeing immediate drop in new large-batch requests.
maria: rollback/revert at 1827654315 started on 20% traffic. metrics: error-rate slice with revert dropped from 7.8% to 0.9% within 2 minutes.
elaine: excellent. keep timeline & hypotheses in thread. we'll do an RCA doc after stabilization. For now: status = mitigation in progress, partial revert successful, ongoing log collection.
sam: attaching minimal diff for revert so SRE can replay if needed:
```
- batch_window_ms = max(8, computed)
+ batch_window_ms = max(4, computed)
```
rebecca: note for postmortem: include customer list of affected orgs and token-level tracing for failed requests. I'll start that list.
matt: postmortem owners volunteers? I'll take infra portion (kernel/kernel-tuning interactions). @maria will take runtime config/feature flags. @sam will take code change & regression tests. @rebecca takes customer impact. @anil handles monitoring/alerts.
elaine: agreed. moving to watch mode for 30m after full revert. If error rate stays <1% we'll declare mitigated. Otherwise escalate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (partial revert + rate-limits). Current status: stabilizing. Link: #incident-1827654321
